title: Plant Regeneration: Influencing Factors, Regulatory Networks, and Epigenetic Mechanisms.
authors: Song, Wenke; Cheng, Xin; Liu, Xinmin; Wang, Limei; Li, Maoteng
one_liner_zh: 综述植物再生的影响因素、调控网络与表观遗传机制，虽提及AI辅助预测等新兴技术，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Plant tissue culture is a crucial part of biotechnology that supports crop improvement, plant conservation, and other related fields. Although tissue culture has been successfully used in many plants, low regeneration and transformation rates still exist in some species. Agrobacterium-mediated transformation is commonly used in genetic engineering, but its effectiveness depends heavily on establishing a reliable in vitro regeneration system through organogenesis or somatic embryogenesis. Over the past decade, substantial progress has been made in understanding the molecular basis of regeneration; however, most reviews have focused on individual aspects such as hormone regulation or transcription factor networks in isolation. In contrast, this review provides a comprehensive and integrated framework that systematically links four critical layers-wound signaling, hormonal regulation, developmental regulators, and epigenetic modifications-into a unified regulatory network governing plant regeneration. Furthermore, we highlight recent cutting-edge advances, including artificial intelligence-assisted prediction, single-cell and spatial transcriptomics, epigenome editing, and CRISPR-based activation systems, and we discuss their transformative potential in overcoming genotype-dependent recalcitrance. By synthesizing classical regulatory mechanisms with emerging technologies, this review offers a forward-looking perspective that distinguishes it from earlier publications and provides both theoretical foundations and practical strategies for improving plant regeneration and genetic transformation.
abstract_zh: 植物组织培养是生物技术中的一个关键组成部分，支持作物改良、植物保护及其他相关领域。尽管组织培养已在许多植物中成功应用，但在某些物种中仍存在再生率和转化率低的问题。农杆菌介导的转化是基因工程中常用的方法，但其有效性在很大程度上依赖于通过器官发生或体细胞胚胎发生建立可靠的体外再生系统。过去十年中，在理解再生的分子基础方面取得了显著进展；然而，大多数综述仅孤立地关注激素调控或转录因子网络等单一层面。相比之下，本综述提供了一个全面且整合的框架，系统地将四个关键层面——创伤信号、激素调控、发育调控因子和表观遗传修饰——连接成一个统一的调控网络，以管理植物再生。此外，我们强调了最新的前沿进展，包括人工智能辅助预测、单细胞和空间转录组学、表观基因组编辑以及基于CRISPR的激活系统，并讨论了它们在克服基因型依赖性顽固性方面的变革潜力。通过综合经典调控机制与新兴技术，本综述提供了一个前瞻性的视角，使其区别于早期出版物，并为改善植物再生和遗传转化提供了理论基础和实践策略。
